Title: DownloadsPageComponent — Application Download Page
Summary: Standalone component at /#/download showing two distinct Cyréna products: Desktop (Windows x64/ARM64, Linux x64/ARM64, macOS coming soon) and HUD (Windows x64 only). Each product shows per-architecture build rows with download buttons ready for real URLs. Only x64 and ARM64 architectures are supported — x86 has been removed.
Content:
## DownloadsPageComponent

**Selector:** `app-downloads-page`  
**Route:** `/#/download` (lazy-loaded)  
**Location:** `src/app/features/downloads/components/downloads-page/downloads-page.component.ts`

### Architecture
- Standalone component with `OnPush` change detection.
- Uses signals for all state (`desktopProduct`, `hudProduct`, `allReleasesUrl`).
- Imports `CommonModule` and `RouterLink`.
- No services or HTTP calls — all data is static/signal-driven.
- Helper methods `platformKeys()` and `buildsForPlatform()` iterate the `platforms` map safely in templates.

### Interface: ProductBuild

```typescript
interface ProductBuild {
  architecture: string;   // e.g. 'x64', 'ARM64'
  size: string;           // e.g. '~50 MB'
  downloadUrl: string | null;
  isAvailable: boolean;
}
```

### Interface: DownloadProduct

```typescript
interface DownloadProduct {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  tagline: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;             // Bootstrap Icons class
  version: string;
  releaseDate: string;
  platforms: {
    windows?: ProductBuild[];
    linux?: ProductBuild[];
    macos?: ProductBuild[];
  };
  requirements: string[];
  screenshotUrl?: string | null;
}
```

### State Signals

| Signal | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `desktopProduct` | `DownloadProduct` | Cyréna Desktop — windowed interface. Windows (x64, ARM64), Linux (x64, ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon/Intel, coming soon). Tagline: "Offline-first. Model-agnostic. Traditional windowed interface." Description: "Chat, extensions, coding tools, and all platform capabilities in a traditional windowed interface. Runs entirely on your machine with optional cloud model connections." |
| `hudProduct` | `DownloadProduct` | Cyréna HUD — overlay interface. Windows only (x64). Screenshot set to `images/hud/screenshot.png`. Tagline: "A Heads Up Display that keeps Cyréna always within reach." Description: "A lightweight overlay that floats above your workspace for quick access to Cyréna without leaving your current window. All your chats, extensions, and AI capabilities in a compact UI. Configurable hotkey to show and hide — runs in the background, out of your way. Windows only." |
| `allReleasesUrl` | `string` | GitHub releases page URL for "View Releases" CTA. |
| `platformLabels` | `Record<string, {name, icon}>` | Display names and Bootstrap Icons for `windows`, `linux`, `macos`. |

### Hero Tagline

> Desktop or HUD — same capabilities, different interaction. Choose your setup.

The hero subtitle explicitly frames Desktop and HUD as equals — same features, different UI paradigm. No product is positioned as "full" or "better."

### Download URLs

All builds are now live with the following URLs. Only x64 and ARM64 architectures are supported — x86 has been removed.

#### Cyréna Desktop

| Platform | Architecture | URL | Size |
|----------|-------------|-----|------|
| Windows | x64 | `/desktop/win-x64-setup.exe` | ~50 MB |
| Windows | ARM64 | `/desktop/win-arm64-setup.exe` | ~50 MB |
| Linux | x64 | `/desktop/linux-x64.zip` | ~50 MB |
| Linux | ARM64 | `/desktop/linux-arm64.zip` | ~50 MB |
| macOS | Apple Silicon / Intel | Coming soon | ~50 MB |

#### Cyréna HUD (ClickOnce)

| Platform | Architecture | URL | Size |
|----------|-------------|-----|------|
| Windows | x64 | `/hud/win-x64/Cyrena.HUD.application` | ~210 MB |

HUD uses ClickOnce deployment. The `.application` file is the ClickOnce manifest that handles installation.

### System Requirements

#### Cyréna Desktop
- 8 GB RAM minimum
- 500 MB free disk space
- libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 (Linux only)
- Ollama (optional, for local models)

Operating systems are not listed as requirements — the platform cards (Windows, Linux, macOS) communicate OS support visually. The only OS-specific catch is the `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0` dependency for Linux distributions.

#### Cyréna HUD
- 8 GB RAM minimum

No other requirements. HUD is a standalone product — it does not depend on Cyréna Desktop. It contains the same platform, chats, extensions, and AI capabilities as Desktop; only the UI differs (overlay vs. windowed application). No OS or processor requirements are listed — the "Windows Only" badge on the build card and the product description communicate platform support.

### Alert Banners

Both product sections display two alert banners below their build cards:

#### 1. Windows SmartScreen Warning (`alert alert-warning`)

> **Windows SmartScreen warning during alpha.** While Cyréna is in alpha, Windows may show a SmartScreen or Defender warning when running the installer. This is expected for unsigned applications — click *More info* → *Run anyway* to proceed.

- Uses `bi-shield-exclamation` icon
- Yellow/warning styling (`alert-warning`)
- Appears on both Desktop and HUD sections because both have Windows installers
- In Desktop section: placed after platform cards, before System Requirements
- In HUD section: placed after Windows Only Card, before Requirements

#### 2. Local Model Resource Note (`alert alert-info`)

> **Local models need more resources.** Running AI models locally (via Ollama) requires additional RAM and VRAM depending on model size — typically 4–16 GB extra. Cloud models like OpenAI have no extra requirements beyond the base 8 GB.

- Uses `bi-cpu` icon
- Blue/info styling (`alert-info`)
- Appears on both Desktop and HUD sections because both products support local model connections
- In Desktop section: placed after System Requirements card
- In HUD section: placed after Requirements card

### Page Sections (HTML)

1. **Hero** — Blue gradient hero matching the extensions page. Badge "Get Cyréna", heading "Download Cyréna", tagline.
2. **Cyréna Desktop** — `bg-light` section. Product header with icon, name, tagline, description. Platform cards in a responsive grid (`col-md-6 col-lg-4`). Each card uses Bootstrap `card border-0 shadow-sm` with hover lift:
   - Platform icon and name in card header
   - Build rows: architecture badge, size, download button (enabled when `isAvailable && downloadUrl`) or "Soon" disabled button
   - **SmartScreen warning alert** after platform cards
   - Shared system requirements card below the grid (also a `shadow-sm` card)
   - **Local model resource alert** below the requirements card
3. **Cyréna HUD** — White section. Product header. Two-column layout:
   - Left: Screenshot card (`images/hud/screenshot.png` when available, placeholder otherwise)
   - Right: Feature highlight badges (Configurable Hotkey, Hide/Show Overlay, Background Mode), description, Windows-only build card with "Only" badge, **SmartScreen warning alert**, requirements card, **local model resource alert**
4. **macOS Notice** — `bg-light` section. Centered card explaining macOS is not yet available.
5. **GitHub Releases CTA** — White section. Centered card with GitHub link.
6. **Getting Started CTA** — `bg-light` section. Centered card with `routerLink` to `/docs/getting-started`.

### HUD Feature Highlights

Three pill badges displayed above the HUD description in the details column:

| Badge | Icon | Color | Description |
|-------|------|-------|-------------|
| Configurable Hotkey | `bi-keyboard` | Primary (blue) | User-defined keyboard shortcut to toggle the overlay |
| Hide / Show Overlay | `bi-eye-slash` | Success (green) | Toggle visibility without closing the application |
| Background Mode | `bi-window` | Info (cyan) | Runs in the background, stays out of the way until summoned |

### Visual Design

The downloads page follows the same light-theme pattern as the extensions landing page:
- **Hero:** Blue gradient (`#0a1628` → `#1a3a5c` → `#0d6efd`) with white text, radial glow decoration
- **Sections:** Alternate between white and `bg-light` (`#f8f9fa`) for visual rhythm
- **Cards:** White `card border-0 shadow-sm` with `translateY(-4px)` hover lift and deeper shadow
- **Icons:** 48×48 or 56×56 rounded-3 containers with `bg-primary bg-opacity-10`, icon in `text-primary`
- **Badges:** `bg-secondary bg-opacity-10 text-secondary` for architecture labels; colored pill badges for feature highlights
- **Buttons:** `btn-primary` for active downloads, `btn-outline-secondary` disabled for "Soon"
- **Alerts:** `alert alert-warning border-0` for SmartScreen warning (yellow, `bi-shield-exclamation`); `alert alert-info border-0` for local model note (blue, `bi-cpu`)

### CSS Classes

| Class | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `.downloads-hero` | Blue gradient hero with radial glow decoration, white text |
| `.product-section` | Section wrapper with `5rem` vertical padding |
| `.product-card` | White card with hover lift (`translateY(-4px)`) |
| `.build-row` | Flex row for architecture badge + size + download button |
| `.macos-section` | `bg-light` section for macOS notice |
| `.github-section` | White section for GitHub releases CTA |
| `.cta-section` | `bg-light` section for Getting Started CTA |

### HUD Screenshot

The HUD screenshot is set to `images/hud/screenshot.png`. Place the screenshot at `public/images/hud/screenshot.png` (or `src/assets/images/hud/screenshot.png` depending on asset configuration). The template shows the image when `screenshotUrl` is truthy, otherwise a placeholder.

### Route Registration

Registered in `app.routes.ts` as a lazy-loaded standalone route:

```typescript
{
  path: 'download',
  loadComponent: () => import('./features/downloads/components/downloads-page/downloads-page.component')
    .then(m => m.DownloadsPageComponent)
}
```

### Navigation

Added to `NavbarComponent.navItems` as `{ label: 'Download', route: '/download' }`, positioned second in the nav (after Home).
